content.short: Discover Paradex, a highly optimized DeFi Dapps protocol focusing on decentralized derivatives to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Paradex is an app-chain orderbook DEX built on Starknet, offering high-performance perpetuals trading with self-custody. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Paradex redefines how users interact with decentralized derivatives. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Starknet to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Paradex stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
content.meta: Paradex provides innovative decentralized derivatives tools for the DeFi Dapps space. Discover Paradex and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
